Footer.tagline: Financial intelligence that helps you make better decisions.

hero.subtitle: VCFO is a financial intelligence platform that turns your accounting data into trusted financial statements, clear metrics, and analysis that helps you understand your company and decide with confidence.

trust.tagline: Built to create one trusted source of financial truth

problem.title: The problem is not a lack of data
problem.subtitle: The problem is that financial data is usually scattered, unstructured, and hard to turn into a clear decision.

excel.title: Too many Excel files
excel.body: Data is scattered across files and different reports.

mismatch.title: Mismatched accounts
mismatch.body: Account names and codes differ across systems and branches.

manual.title: Manual analysis
manual.body: Extracting metrics and comparisons takes time and effort.

unclear.title: Hard to see what is really happening
unclear.body: The numbers exist, but the story behind them is not clear.

solution.title: VCFO builds an intelligence layer on your financial data

how.title: From an Excel file to a clear financial picture in simple steps

step1.title: Upload your data
step1.body: Upload a Trial Balance or Chart of Accounts.

step2.title: VCFO organizes the data
step2.body: The system cleans and unifies the data automatically.

step3.title: Account mapping
step3.body: Your company accounts are mapped to the correct financial classification.

step5.title: Get Financial Truth
step5.body: A single trusted financial layer is created and used to build:

truth.title: One source of financial truth
truth.subtitle: Instead of every report recalculating numbers its own way, VCFO builds one Financial Truth layer that the entire platform depends on.
truth.footer: Calculated once, used everywhere across the platform.

statements.title: See your company's financial position immediately

cashflow.title: See where cash comes from and where it goes.
cashflow.subtitle: Profit is not enough. Cash flow shows how liquidity actually moves inside the company, and whether operations generate cash or consume it.

operating.title: Cash from operating activities
operating.body: See how much cash the core business actually generates.

investing.title: Cash from investing activities
investing.body: Track cash used or generated by investments and asset purchases or sales.

financing.title: Cash from financing activities
financing.body: Understand how loans, capital, and distributions affect liquidity.

cashflow.note: Connect profit to liquidity and see whether the business actually generates cash.

analytics.title: Don't just know the number. Understand its direction.

mom.title: Month over month
mom.body: Compare performance from one month to the next.

yoy.title: Year over year
yoy.body: Compare the period with the same period last year.

expenses.title: Expense analysis
expenses.body: What is rising, falling, and affecting profitability?

health.title: How healthy is your company financially?
health.note: This score is based on explainable financial metrics, not AI guesswork.

multi.title: All your companies and branches in one place

quality.title: Before we tell you what is happening, we make sure the data is right
quality.subtitle: VCFO does not hide data problems. When it finds an issue, it tells you where it is and what needs review.
quality.notFound: Not found in the chart of accounts

errors.title: Issues are visible and reviewable
errors.note: You can edit the file and re-upload it, or handle the cases that the system allows you to handle within the platform.

security.title: Your financial data needs more than a pretty interface
security.subtitle: Every important action can be traced, and each company's data is isolated from the others.

aicfo.title: Next, you will not just read the numbers. You will talk to them.
aicfo.subtitle: The VCFO intelligent financial advisor
aicfo.question: Why did net profit drop this month?
aicfo.answer2: versus last month, mainly because operating expenses rose by
aicfo.followUp: Do you want me to break down the expenses with the biggest impact?
aicfo.footer: Every answer is grounded in Financial Truth, not guesswork.

caps.title: From reports to a financial advisor

rec1.title: Reduce expenses
rec1.body: Identify activities or line items that can be reduced without hurting core performance.
rec1.impact: Impact: potential 6–10% reduction in operating cost

rec2.title: Improve profitability
rec2.body: Find opportunities to lift margins or improve revenue mix through financial comparison.
rec2.impact: Impact: better margin through a healthier revenue mix

rec3.title: Strengthen liquidity
rec3.body: Assess cash movement and see when a financing or operating decision is needed.
rec3.impact: Impact: better cash management and funding timing

scenarios.title: Scenarios — what if something changes?
scenarios.subtitle: Move the assumptions and see the expected impact on revenue, profit, and cash before you decide.
scenarios.explanationBody: When this scenario is applied, net profit is expected to reach {projected}, with a positive impact on profitability and liquidity if the current trend of decline or improvement continues.

forecast.title: Don't look only at the past

pricing.title: A clear plan for every stage of your company
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes data upload, validation, and Financial Truth. No setup fees.
pricing.starterDesc: For one company starting to organize its financial data.
pricing.growthDesc: For multi-branch companies that need deeper analysis.
pricing.enterpriseDesc: For groups that need governance and dedicated support.
pricing.bannerBody: Upload one file and we will show you your company's financial picture before you pay anything.

compliance.title: Enterprise-grade security for your financial data
compliance.subtitle: Financial data is among a company's most sensitive assets. VCFO is built with clear controls for protection, encryption, access, and a full audit trail.

protection.title: Data protection
protection.body: Each company's data is fully isolated, with daily backups and a clear recovery plan.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.body: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with managed encryption keys.

access.title: Access and permissions
access.body: Fine-grained permissions by role, company, and branch, with least privilege and 2FA.

audit.title: Audit and compliance
audit.body: A full audit log for every action, and lineage from every number back to the source file.

hosting.title: Reliable hosting
hosting.body: Cloud infrastructure with continuous monitoring and a regional hosting option.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Your data stays yours. We do not use financial data to train models, and you can delete it anytime.

compliance.matrixNote: Every permission change is logged and can be reviewed later.

testimonials.title: Finance teams that rely on VCFO to decide
testimonials.q1: We used to spend a full week preparing monthly statements. Now we upload the trial balance and get the full picture in minutes.
testimonials.q2: The biggest change is that everyone now debates the same numbers. No report has a different version of the truth.
testimonials.q3: Comparing branch performance was the hardest part of our work. Today it is one screen we open at the start of every meeting.
testimonials.q4: Data validation saved us from errors that used to appear too late. The system tells you exactly where the problem is.
testimonials.q5: The cash flow statement changed how we plan liquidity. We now know earlier when we will need funding.

cta.title: Start building a clear financial picture of your company
cta.subtitle: Upload your financial data, let VCFO organize and validate it, then start understanding your numbers more clearly.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: VCFO is a financial intelligence platform that turns accounting data into trusted statements, metrics, and analysis that help you decide.
faq.a2: You can upload a Trial Balance or Chart of Accounts as Excel or CSV.
faq.q3: Do I need to replace my accounting system?
faq.a3: No. VCFO sits on top of your current system's outputs. You do not need to replace it.
faq.q4: Can I manage more than one company?
faq.a4: Yes. You can manage multiple companies with full data isolation between them.
faq.a5: Yes. You can manage branches, view all branches, and compare them within the same company.
faq.q6: How does the system handle file errors?
faq.a6: It shows a clear list of issues with the affected account or row. You can fix the file and re-upload it, or resolve allowed cases in-app.
faq.a7: It is a single financial layer where each number is calculated once, then used by statements, metrics, and analytics across the platform.
faq.a8: Yes. Tenant isolation, role-based access, an audit log, and full data lineage are built in.
faq.a9: Metrics and scores are based on explainable financial rules. The interpretive AI layer is coming later.
faq.q10: Can I talk to the financial advisor?
faq.a10: The intelligent financial advisor is coming soon, and its answers will be grounded in your company's Financial Truth.

About.title: We build one source of financial truth
About.intro: VCFO is a financial intelligence platform for companies. We do not replace your accounting system. We sit on top of your data: clean it, unify it, validate it, then turn it into statements, metrics, and analysis leadership can trust.

truth.title: Truth first
truth.body: Each number is calculated once inside Financial Truth, then reused across every screen and report.

clarity.title: Clarity over guesswork
clarity.body: Metrics are built on explainable financial rules, not opaque AI answers.

built.title: Built for companies
built.body: Multi-company, branches, periods, permissions, and an audit trail from day one.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: On the marketing site we may collect limited technical data such as approximate IP address, browser type, pages visited, and CTA clicks. If you contact us on WhatsApp, that conversation is also processed under WhatsApp's policies.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand and improve site usage. IP anonymization is enabled, and we never use your financial data to train models. You can block tracking via browser settings or privacy extensions.

product.title: Product data
product.body: If you become a customer, your financial data remains yours. Each company is isolated, data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we do not sell it or use it to train AI models.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data. Contact the VCFO team on WhatsApp or via the contact section.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: By using vcfo-ai.com or requesting access to the product, you agree to these terms. If you use the service on behalf of a company, you confirm you have authority to bind that company.

nature.title: Nature of the service
nature.body: VCFO is a financial intelligence tool that helps organize data and produce statements and metrics. It is not binding accounting, tax, or legal advice and does not replace a licensed accountant or auditor.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of files you upload, for managing your team's permissions, and for keeping login credentials secure.

pricing.title: Pricing and cancellation
pricing.body: Listed prices may change. Billing and cancellation details are set in your subscription agreement or quote.
